description.en: Lily, an adult woman in her mid-twenties with long wavy chestnut-brown hair, fair skin, large hazel-green eyes and a slender build, wearing an ivory silk wedding gown with a fitted bodice and a long zipper down the back. The portrait fixes her identity and gown; the opening frame and shot description fix her pose and position.

description.en: Killian, a very tall, broad-shouldered adult man in his early thirties with short swept-back black hair, a sharp jawline, light stubble and cold dark-gray eyes, wearing a tailored black three-piece suit, white shirt and dark tie, with a platinum luxury wristwatch on his left wrist. description.en: The private VIP fitting room of a high-end bridal boutique: cream walls with gold molding, a heavy dark-wood door with a brass handle in the left wall, a tall gold-framed standing mirror on the right wall, a rack of long white gowns in garment covers along the back wall, an ivory velvet couch and thick carpet, lit warmly by a crystal chandelier and wall sconces. voice_description.en: A mature adult male voice in a deep chest register, low and unhurried with a husky edge, speaking clear Mandarin in a quiet, controlled, menacing tone. He never shouts, and every word is fully voiced and audible.

episodes.summary: 第1轮试验片，共15个任务，所有任务使用同一个种子1001；每组A/B只改一个写法，用来比较哪种写法更稳。

Lily：“基利安，你疯了吗？”

Killian：“你逃不掉的。”

Killian：“别动，看镜子。”

Lily：“我要嫁给保罗了。”
L-A 长台词，22个字放在一个10秒任务里。
Killian：“你养父母欠了我三千万美金，从今天起搬进我的别墅。”

Killian：“你养父母欠了我三千万美金。”
L-B2 短台词，把长台词拆开，下半句。
Killian：“从今天起，搬进我的别墅。”
K-A 两个连续动作，拉拉链、转身微笑。
K-B 一个动作，拉拉链。
